envelope.description: Make readEpicDefinitionCore the single work-item head reader

body.title: Make readEpicDefinitionCore the single work-item head reader
body.summary: In storage.ts: readArtifactCore also reads meta.tracker; EpicDefinitionCore gains headKind and tracker; readEpicDefinitionCore tries DEF, then ISSUE, then the lowest-ordinal LLD-<h>-<story>, reporting an LLD head with standalone: true and createdAt = epicCreatedAt ?? createdAt. All existing consumers (inheritedEpicSlug, inheritedStandalone, inheritedStoryStandalone, readEpicCreatedAt, buildRecordFolderArgs, validate resolveRouteFlag) then see LLD heads with no code change of their own.
acceptanceChecks: DEF beats ISSUE beats LLD; a lone LLD (flagged or unflagged) heads its hash with headKind 'LLD' and standalone: true; lowest-ordinal LLD wins; malformed LLD -> {}.
DEF/ISSUE heads keep their existing fields and now also carry tracker.
A legacy unflagged LLD-only item's BUILD/TESTS placement resolves to docs/standalone.
finalizePlan for an LLD-only standalone work item inherits the LLD's slug and writes PLAN.md into the LLD's folder.

tests.name: readEpicDefinitionCore head precedence, LLD fallback, standalone:true and tracker
legacy unflagged LLD-only item: BUILD/TESTS placed under docs/standalone
finalizePlan writes PLAN.md into the anchor LLD's folder
